title: Allotment.
bodyText: Contracts to disburse and appropriations for grants shall be subject to the allotment system generally applicable to all appropriations made by the legislature.
bodyHtml: §42F-105  Allotment.  Contracts to disburse and appropriations for grants shall be subject to the allotment system generally applicable to all appropriations made by the legislature. [L 1997, c 190, pt of §3; am L 2014, c 96, §9]
